description: This file defines the Validator class in the AWS SDK for PHP, responsible for validating data structures against a defined schema, including type checks, size constraints, and pattern matching.

classes.name: Validator
classes.description: A class that provides schema validation functionalities for AWS API request and response data.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates input data against a schema, throwing an exception if invalid.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches validation checks based on data type.

methods.name: check_structure
methods.description: Validates structured objects, including required fields and nested validation.

methods.name: check_string
methods.description: Validates string data, including pattern matching.

methods.name: validateRange
methods.description: Checks if a value falls within specified min/max constraints.

methods.name: checkAssociativeArray
methods.description: Determines if an array is associative.

methods.name: checkDocumentType
methods.description: Checks if a value matches a document type schema.

methods.name: checkUnion
methods.description: Validates union types, ensuring exactly one non-null value.

methods.name: addError
methods.description: Records a validation error message with current path context.

methods.name: canJsonEncode
methods.description: Checks if data can be JSON encoded.
